symptoms: Charge-density mixing or electronic convergence instability. Custodian skips this correction for charged calculations with NELECT set.
candidate_actions: If a valid OUTCAR exists, try continuing with ISTART = 1.
Try Kerker mixing by setting IMIX = 1.
If the issue persists, try switching the KPOINTS generation style between Gamma and Monkhorst.
Disable symmetry with ISYM = 0 if safer earlier fixes fail.
If ICHARG < 10 and repeated attempts fail, delete CHGCAR and WAVECAR before restarting.
text: Custodian handles brmix progressively: continue from existing wavefunction, try IMIX = 1, adjust Gamma/Monkhorst k-point style, then disable symmetry and remove CHGCAR/WAVECAR for non-fixed-charge runs. Prefer minimal INCAR/KPOINTS edits first.

symptoms: Numerical noise in forces during ionic relaxation, often near a minimum for large/flexible structures, surfaces, zeolites, or MOFs. Frequently occurs with IBRION = 2.
candidate_actions: If CONTCAR is valid, copy CONTCAR to POSCAR to continue from the latest geometry.
Tighten EDIFF, usually to 1e-6 or by a factor of 10 until about 1e-8.
Set NELMIN = 8 to improve force quality.
If the first continuation fails, switch to IBRION = 1 cautiously.
If VTST optimizers are available, FIRE via IOPT = 7, IBRION = 3, POTIM = 0 can be more robust.
text: Custodian treats zbrent as force noise near relaxation minima. It first preserves progress by copying CONTCAR to POSCAR, tightens EDIFF, sets NELMIN = 8, and only later changes IBRION to 1 to avoid a zbrent/brions loop.

patterns: Error EDDDAV: Call to ZHEGV failed
symptoms: Failure in Davidson diagonalization, sometimes related to charge density, unstable ALGO settings, or parallel/load-balancing issues.
candidate_actions: If CONTCAR is valid, copy CONTCAR to POSCAR before restarting.
If ICHARG < 10, delete CHGCAR to avoid reusing a bad charge density.
Switch ALGO to All and set ISEARCH = 1 when ALGO is not already All.
For small systems with parallelization issues, consider increasing NCORE and unsetting NPAR, but use this carefully in scheduler contexts.
text: Custodian handles edddav by continuing from CONTCAR when possible, removing CHGCAR for non-fixed-charge runs, changing ALGO to All with ISEARCH = 1, and considering NCORE/NPAR changes for load-balancing issues.

patterns: WARNING in EDDRMM: call to ZHEGV failed
symptoms: RMM-DIIS algorithm instability during electronic minimization or ionic relaxation.
candidate_actions: If CONTCAR is valid, copy CONTCAR to POSCAR before restarting.
If ALGO is Fast or VeryFast, switch ALGO to Normal.
Otherwise reduce POTIM by half for relaxation jobs.
If ICHARG < 10, delete CHGCAR and WAVECAR before restart.
text: Custodian treats eddrmm as RMM algorithm instability: continue from CONTCAR, switch Fast/VeryFast to Normal, reduce POTIM if needed, and remove CHGCAR/WAVECAR for a cleaner restart.

symptoms: Matrix factorization failure. Often caused by short bond distances, too large ionic step, symmetry problems, or NCORE/NPAR settings that are too large for a small structure.
candidate_actions: Disable symmetry with ISYM = 0.
For very small structures using NCORE > 1 or NPAR > 1, set NCORE = 1 and unset NPAR.
For relaxation jobs, if failure occurs before ionic progress, inspect geometry and consider expanding POSCAR only with human review.
If ionic steps exist, reduce POTIM by half.
text: Custodian handles zpotrf by turning off symmetry, reducing parallelization for small structures, and reducing POTIM if relaxation has already started. Geometry-changing fixes are high risk and should be conservative.

patterns: WARNING: Sub-Space-Matrix is not hermitian in DAV
symptoms: Subspace diagonalization instability, sometimes from real-space projection or precision settings, and sometimes from parallelization on small systems.
candidate_actions: If LREAL is not False, set LREAL = False.
If the issue recurs and PREC is not Accurate, set PREC = Accurate.
Consider reducing cores or adjusting NCORE/NPAR outside INCAR patching if the structure is small.
text: Custodian first disables real-space projection for subspacematrix, then raises precision to Accurate on recurrence. These are relatively safe INCAR edits for numerical stability.

candidate_actions: Set LREAL = False when it is not already False.
text: Custodian groups rspher with real_optlay and nicht_konv; the safe correction is to disable real-space projection by setting LREAL = False.

patterns: BRIONS problems: POTIM should be increased
symptoms: Ionic optimizer problem, often related to POTIM and relaxation algorithm.
candidate_actions: If CONTCAR is valid, copy CONTCAR to POSCAR to preserve progress.
Increase POTIM slightly.
If the problem recurs with IBRION = 1, switch to IBRION = 2 and reset POTIM to 0.5.
text: Custodian handles brions by preserving CONTCAR, increasing POTIM, and switching from IBRION = 1 to IBRION = 2 with POTIM = 0.5 if repeated.

patterns: number of bands is not sufficient
symptoms: NBANDS is too small for the calculation.
candidate_actions: Increase NBANDS by at least 10 percent, or by at least one band for small values.
text: Custodian increases NBANDS to max(int(1.1 * NBANDS), NBANDS + 1) when too_few_bands or nbands_not_sufficient is detected.

symptoms: Subspace rotation diagonalization error, often sensitive to ALGO.
candidate_actions: If ALGO is not Normal, set ALGO = Normal.
text: Custodian changes ALGO to Normal for PSSYEVX/PDSYEVX errors when a different ALGO is set.

patterns: ERROR EDDIAG: Call to routine ZHEEV failed
ERROR in EDDIAG: call to ZHEEV/ZHEEVX/DSYEV/DSYEVX failed
candidate_actions: If CONTCAR is valid, copy CONTCAR to POSCAR.
Try ALGO = Normal first.
If the problem recurs, try ALGO = exact.
text: Custodian handles zheev/eddiag by continuing from CONTCAR, switching to ALGO Normal, and later trying exact diagonalization.

candidate_actions: Set ISMEAR = 0 and SIGMA = 0.05.
For related tetirr/incorrect_shift with Monkhorst KPOINTS, switch KPOINTS generation style to Gamma.
text: Custodian handles tetrahedron failures by using Gaussian smearing-like safe settings ISMEAR = 0 and SIGMA = 0.05, and for related shift errors may switch Monkhorst to Gamma.

patterns: Fatal error: unable to match k-point
Found some non-integer element in rotation matrix
candidate_actions: Try disabling symmetry with ISYM = 0.
For rotation matrix problems, reduce SYMPREC such as SYMPREC = 1e-8 when appropriate.
For Monkhorst KPOINTS symmetry issues, switch generation style to Gamma.
text: Custodian uses conservative symmetry fixes: disable ISYM, tighten SYMPREC for selected errors, and switch Monkhorst grids to Gamma for some rotation/kmesh problems.

symptoms: Input parsing/read error, often from malformed INCAR entries or file formatting problems.
candidate_actions: Inspect the exact log line and the corresponding input file before editing.
Prefer removing or replacing malformed INCAR assignments rather than adding new settings.
Do not guess a physics correction if the error is purely syntax or formatting.
text: Custodian detects read_error but syntax fixes should be driven by the exact error line. In SimMOF, use the log excerpt and input files to produce a minimal patch.

patterns: WARNING: wrap around error must be expected
symptoms: FFT mesh aliasing / wrap-around warning. Not always fatal, but can affect force and energy accuracy.
candidate_actions: Use PREC = Accurate when force accuracy matters.
Increase FFT grid settings such as NGX/NGY/NGZ or augmentation grids only when the warning provides clear suggested values.
Avoid mixing calculations with different PREC/LREAL/FFT settings when comparing energies.
text: Custodian has a separate aliasing handler for wrap-around errors. The VASP manual also describes this as an FFT mesh issue; PREC = Accurate is the conservative first hint.
